newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola called higher, flax and grains steady.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola called higher, flax and grains steady.

text.p: WCE canola futures were called $1.00 to $2.00 per tonne higher, while flaxseed and feed grains were called steady, traders said.
In canola, expected positive crusher margins should prompt crusher buying, they said. Japan remained on holiday which should keep export demand light.
Also supportive was active fieldwork that should keep cash canola sales light, and expected higher CBOT soybeans.
Flaxseed futures were called steady on expected thin trading.
Feed grain futures were called steady. Pressure from cash sales in wheat may be offset by expected strong demand from livestock feeders.
Barley, oats and feed peas were expected to open quietly steady.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
